_comment: Perf-smoke gate configuration. 'blocking' is intentionally false: the gate runs in advisory mode and never fails a PR on its own. Flipping it to true is a deliberate, separate rollout that turns the aggregate 'perf-smoke-test' commit status into an enforcing required check. runtime_compatibility is intentionally omitted here so it is sourced from gate_config.DEFAULT_RUNTIME_COMPATIBILITY (see gate_config.py); add a key only to override the code default.
